Practised checking answers by estimating first.
Estimated 398 + 201 near 600 and 7,200 − 3,900 near 3,300.

end.parentNote: Kabir practised estimating before checking addition and subtraction answers. They used rounding in several examples, including 4,982 and 3,015 near 8,000. They mixed up an estimate with an exact answer and needed support with borrowing; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask them to label each answer “estimate” or “exact” before calculating, using place-value drawings for borrowing.
